sources.label: BDO Tether Gold Reserves Report as of September 30, 2026, 11:59 PM UTC (signed and authorised October 30; re-verified November 6, 2026)

reserveReview.rationale: The September 30, 2026 Tether Gold Reserves Report identifies the complete direct reserve as London Good Delivery physical gold vaulted in Switzerland. At 11:59 PM UTC it reports 827,417.630 fine troy ounces against 827,417.630000 XAUT in circulation and minted, comprising 709,323.660000 sold and 118,093.970000 available for sale. BDO's ISAE 3000R reasonable-assurance opinion, signed October 30, verifies inventory and accounting-ledger-to-blockchain liability reconciliation and is unmodified. This is the report's historical point-in-time reserve, not a current custody, liquidity or deployment-partition assessment.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete direct reserve asset is identified as physical gold; custodian identity and provider allocation remain unknown and are recorded in the custody profile.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The report states that the gold is vaulted in Switzerland, is owned by XAUT token holders rather than TG Commodities, and gives holders undivided ownership rights to specified bars. It does not name the custodian, disclose provider shares or the custody agreement, prohibit rehypothecation, or provide a legal opinion testing insolvency treatment.
